name: Greystones

branding.name: Clean Greystones
branding.description: Report dog fouling in Greystones, see how many reports were logged this month, and write to your councillors.

legal.offence: Leaving dog faeces on a public road, footpath, beach or park is an offence under section 22 of the Litter Pollution Act 1997.
legal.fineWording: It may result in a fixed penalty.
legal.fixedPaymentNote: A Department notice on section 36 of the Circular Economy and Miscellaneous Provisions Act 2022 (commenced 1 September 2026) describes fixed payments for littering generally. It is not a verified dog-fouling penalty amount.

email.intro: I am a resident of Greystones, Co. Wicklow. I am writing about dog fouling on footpaths, the seafront and other public places.

templates.label: A factual note
templates.description: Share the reports logged this month and ask for them to be noted.
templates.subject: Dog fouling reports in Greystones
templates.ask: I would be grateful if these reports could be noted at the next Greystones Municipal District meeting.

templates.label: A request for patrols
templates.description: Ask for attention on busy footpaths and the seafront.
templates.subject: Request for patrols in Greystones
templates.ask: I would be grateful if litter patrols could include the seafront, Church Road and other busy footpaths, especially on weekend mornings.

templates.label: A request for bins
templates.description: Ask the council to look at bins on walking routes.
templates.subject: Request for bins on Greystones walking routes
templates.ask: I would be grateful if the council could review litter bins on walking routes in Greystones.

act.intro: Write to the six Greystones Municipal District councillors. Nothing is sent until you send it from your own email app.

binsNote: Distances use OpenStreetMap litter bins (amenity waste basket) from the 16 October 2026 snapshot. Recycling bring-banks are excluded. This is a comparison of reported spots with mapped bins, not a finding about why people did not use a bin.
